🤭How to make money online selling products on Etsy you didn't make yourself using the done for you designs & print on demand method!  👇🏼Read for a step by step!  🙌🏼 How Print On Demand Works:  1. Do Some Quick Product Research - Look for popular items people are buying, like wall art, t-shirts, sweatshirts, phone cases, candles, mugs, or tote bags.   - Use tools like erank, Google Trends or browse online shops to see what's trending. I also look for inspo on Pinterest all the time! I like to use Everbee to see how much money a product is making on Etsy.  2. Create Your Design  - Get done for you designs on ctrl-alt-design.com  - Or create your own. Make your design fun, eye-catching, or niche-specific. Keep it simple and high-quality!   3. Sign Up on Printify  - Create a free account & make sure you connect your account to a store. Examples being Etsy or Shopify. You are walked through how to do this when you sign up, don’t worry it’s easy and fast.  4. Choose a Product on Printify   - Browse the product catalog for posters, t-shirts, hoodies, candles, hats, mugs, phone cases & etc.   - Select the product you want to sell.   5. Upload Your Design   - Click on the product to customize it.   - Upload your design.   - Position and resize it to fit the product nicely.   6. Fill Out Listing Details  - Write a catchy product title and description with keywords.   - Set your price (consider costs and your profit margin).   7. Publish Your Product  - Remember to connect your online store (Shopify, Etsy, etc.) with Printful . This makes it so whenever you make a sale, Printify knows instantly so it can print the design on the product for you and send it to the customer for you!  - Publish your product so it’s live and ready for customers.   8. Market Your Product - Share your product on social media, use Pinterest, create ads, or tell friends. Make videos of your product or make Pinterest pins.  - Focus on your target audience to attract more buyers. Not a must but it can help!  #howtomakemoneyonline #sidehustle #onlinesidehustle #printondemand #digitalproducts

If you’re selling print-on-demand on Etsy, NOW is the time to start listing your fall products. The biggest mistake I see is waiting until September…by then, shoppers are already buying! 🍁 The products I’m focusing on this season are: 🤎 Gildan 18000 sweatshirts – Cozy season = sweatshirt season. Perfect for pumpkin spice lovers, teachers, bookworms, football moms, Halloween lovers, and anyone looking for that oversized fall aesthetic. 🥪 Canvas lunch bags – Such an underrated product! They’re great for teachers, students, nurses, and anyone packing lunches. Add cute fall florals, ghosts, pumpkins, or teacher-themed designs for an easy seasonal listing. 🥤 Tumblers – Fall drinks are a whole personality. Think pumpkin spice, iced coffee, apple cider, spooky season, or cozy autumn graphics. These also make great gifts. Don’t stop there, though! Here are more fall POD products worth listing on Etsy: 👕 T-Shirts – Perfect for back-to-school, Halloween, apple picking, pumpkin patches, and early fall before sweatshirt weather hits. Great for teacher designs, retro Halloween graphics, and cozy sayings. ☕ Mugs – Once the weather cools down, everyone wants a new coffee or tea mug. Create designs around pumpkin spice, cozy reading, spooky season, fall quotes, or teacher appreciation. 👜 Tote Bags – A customer favorite for teachers, students, book lovers, farmers market shoppers, and everyday errands. Think autumn leaves, books, pumpkins, black cats, or minimalist fall designs. ✨ Stickers – Low-cost impulse buys that are perfect for decorating water bottles, laptops, planners, Kindles, and journals. Bundle cute ghost stickers, pumpkin illustrations, coffee cups, fall leaves, or back-to-school icons into themed collections. 🍂 Pro tip: One great design can become multiple listings. Instead of creating a brand-new design for every product, put the same artwork on a sweatshirt, t-shirt, mug, tumbler, tote bag, lunch bag, and sticker. That’s how you build your Etsy shop faster while reaching more customers. The best time to list fall products is before customers start shopping.
